segments.text: Posting every day means writing the same idea five different ways, then pasting each one into Buffer.
Cascade does that for you. One idea becomes a post made for every channel, sent straight to Buffer.
I connect my Buffer account, and my channels load straight from Buffer.
I write the idea once, the way I'd say it.
I add a photo, and Cascade checks that Buffer can fetch it.
Then I choose where it goes.
Cascade writes a version for each network.
Each post fits its channel, counted the way Buffer counts it, with my X Premium limit read from my account.
It keeps my words, my links and my tags, and never adds hashtags or emojis I didn't write.
I can edit anything, or ask for a fresh version.
For each channel I choose the queue, a time in that channel's time zone, or a draft.

segments.chip: Saved to Buffer Ideas · one post per channel
segments.text: One tap saves my original idea to Buffer Ideas, then creates one post for each channel.
If anything fails, Cascade says why in plain words, and retries only what's missing.
Cascade. One idea, every channel, ready in Buffer. Try it at oncascade dot vercel dot app.
